payload.text: Pick up Hudson from soccer practice at 6, drop off his cleats for the cobbler tomorrow.

notes: Kid-name match elevates to sensitive even when `[area:: personal]` (not in the sensitive area set). Requires OHO_KID_NAMES=Hudson in the runtime env; the fixture's `_test_kid_names` field is for the eval harness to set context. Guards against the failure mode 'sensitive content escapes because area-tag was wrong/missing'.
